name: Funny Monkeys VR
summary:
🐒 Funny Monkeys – A Fast-Paced Gorilla Tag Fan Game
Welcome to Funny Monkeys, the ultimate VR playground where chaos, speed, and monkey business collide! Inspired by the iconic Gorilla Tag, this fan-made experience takes the core of physics-based locomotion and cranks it up with thrilling dashes, expansive maps, and a whole lot of fun.
